body:
commit 19cacd5 (feat(nock): keyframe animator + rig remapping primitives) landed 2026-09-27 10:50 but the running iduna binary was still built from 2026-09-25 10:56 -- verified via strings on the binary (old JS bundle hash Dt0bMwRy present, new BuiknMhy absent). Rebuilt (go build -o ~/.local/bin/iduna .), verified new bundle hash present in the binary, restarted iduna.service (systemd --user), health check passed. New backend routes (keyframes/bone-map/remap-mesh/retarget) confirmed wired into NockAnimationsHandler's existing path dispatch, no main.go registration needed. cmd/nock CLI builds clean (go run convention, no fixed install path in this repo).

⚓ ☃
title: Deployed NOCK keyframe animator + rig remapping (was committed, not live)
